access.session.text: start issues a four-digit session_number; end ends the shared access cycle

executor.session.text: attach-only; session_number is mandatory and may have leading zeros; attachment binds the local work cycle

coordinator.session.text: attach-only; session_number is mandatory and may have leading zeros; attachment binds the local work cycle

executor.task_list.text: read is summary-only, excludes archived tasks; state=done includes done tasks; next_cursor continues pagination

coordinator.task_list.text: read is summary-only, excludes archived tasks; state=done includes done tasks; next_cursor continues pagination

*.message.text: send requires text and forbids message_hash; ack requires message_hash and forbids text; reply requires both
read/history/recipients forbid text and message_hash; recipient resolution and current session are runtime checks
message scope is local or fleet; local is default for mesh roles

executor.task_comment.text: comment requires comment_text; checkpoint requires checkpoint payload; action selects the canonical request model

executor.task_claim.text: claim requires claim_intent; release_reason may be required when an existing live claim is released, determined from current state

coordinator.task_manage.text: create requires isolation_hint; non-create mutation actions require task_id; archive needs archive_note or note; action-dependent requirements come from TaskManageInput
canonical TaskRequest action variants enforce operation-specific fields and runtime transitions after boundary validation; their exact variants are the source for offline cross-check
request_id is a create operation identity: only reuse on transport retry of the same create
coordinator.task_manage.anchor: Create operation identity. Reuse only on transport retries

coordinator.task_manage.text: creating state=done requires a non-null result; when archiving, archive_note or note must be non-null; canonical mutation state checks remain authoritative

executor.command_run.text: a command run executes a shell command in the current managed work session; no implicit idempotency guarantee

coordinator.task_get.text: detail chooses snapshot, detail or history; history_kind and cursor apply to history
